review: Independent host-only review of emitted P19 acceptance artifacts
scope: Read-only review of completed outputs, output provenance, runtime policy JSON, and test source semantics. No TTNN/model/device commands were run by this reviewer. This records evidence, not policy selection.

run.selection_status: P19 remains unselected; review does not select or accept a serving default

accuracy.assessment: All emitted prefill, three decode-repeat rows, and natural-reference rows clear the recorded numerical gate. Exit 0 agrees with the CLI assertion.

runtime_policy.validation: All 60 runtime-policy layer records match the candidate group policy; source_manifest.json has 17 source entries and every current file hash matched.

performance.scope_note: Host end-to-end AR timing, matching the requested B1/C1 4096/128 workload. It is not a device-time roofline measurement.

context_and_memory.source_semantics_review: Test code pre-fills the 262144-token exact-capacity input; for length 262143 it generates one token then decodes at position 262143 and checks the next position is 262144. It also compares eight greedy host-sampled tokens against the device path. The boundary inputs repeat the pinned AIME token sequence to the requested lengths; they test capacity/indexing, not long-context semantic quality.
context_and_memory.memory_note: B1 memory inventory reports 19,306,540,544 owned bytes versus 19,307,376,640 allocator bytes, leaving 836,096 unattributed bytes; no mismatch was found in the recorded accounting.

qualitative.comparison_scope: Same six pinned chat prompts and HF greedy completions, each bounded at 128 generated tokens. These are continuation comparisons, not complete-answer evaluation.

observations.observation: TT and HF haiku texts match exactly; both stop at 19 tokens.
Both continue coherently to the 128-token cap; first divergence at token 21 is a connective change ('and' versus 'while'). Both answers are incomplete at the cap.
TT/HF texts match through the 128-token cap; both story continuations are incomplete.
Both begin with a coherent thermodynamics explanation; divergence at token 83 changes an example/explanation; both stop at the 128-token cap before completing the answer.
TT and HF French-translation responses match exactly and stop naturally at 104 tokens.
Both provide coherent Fibonacci implementation explanations; divergence at token 65 and both are truncated at 128 tokens during code.

long_prefix.format_caveat: The requested JSON-key response is returned inside a Markdown JSON code fence and includes the decoded turn-end marker; the label is correct but this is not strict JSON-only output.
long_prefix.scope_note: One retrieval/control prompt; not a broad long-context quality test.

qualitative.conclusion: No malformed protocol or degenerate continuation was seen in the six bounded shared-control outputs. Token-limited answers and the long-prefix formatting caveat remain explicit; this is not a general qualitative-quality claim.

limits: P19 remains unselected pending root policy decision and the separate resume/serving acceptance work.
One 32,083-token retrieval control and repeated-token boundary probes do not establish broad semantic quality at the advertised context length.
Qualitative comparisons are exact-prefix, deterministic, and capped at 128 tokens; they do not compare complete answers when both sides reach the cap.
